observable_endpoints.assessment: ALM movement-versus-task subspaces and randomized-delay control contrasts are documented; cognition independent of all movement is not identifiable from measured features alone.
observable_endpoints.missing_common_contract: Exact score/estimand, inclusion, figure-specific reference outputs and numerical tolerances must be frozen; source text alone does not establish reproduction.

comparability: Match measured movement completeness, delay/choice labels and subspace rank; residual task signal can reflect unmeasured movement. Do not use exampleData.mat as the paper cohort.
Paper+data versus +official-code arms still need one identical empirical task, matched noncode resources/budgets, separate source exposure, and preserved reproduction→improvement stages.

task_specific_gates: Task is an analysis finding rather than a generic subspace implementation. Residual task information does not prove cognition independent of unmeasured movement; custom analysis code is also in Zenodo.
The live subspaceID GitHub is an example kernel; full paper code is the inspected author Zenodo archive. Do not count exampleData.mat as the paper cohort.
An executable reference, independent metric audit, controls/adversaries, grouped improvement assessment and measured resource envelope remain required for this central scope.
